title: Night Out
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael struggles with gum stuck in his hair and his frustrations with dating, while Ryan mandates a Saturday workday to address issues with the Dunder Mifflin Infinity website. Michael organizes a night out in New York with Dwight, Ryan, and others to party and meet girls. Meanwhile, Jim, Pam, and Stanley get locked out of the office and try to get back in, with Dwight revealing he has the master keys. At the club, Michael tries to impress a girl and sends a picture of Dwight making out with a tall girl to the office. Ryan is beaten up at the club and later, Michael advises him on dealing with a drug problem. Back at the office, various interactions occur including discussions about a Christmas bonus, and Michael reassures Ryan about their friendship.
